data_description.storage_mode: App folder (recommended): backups are stored in a separate app folder on Yandex Disk, and the integration cannot see other files. Disk folder (legacy): backups go to a normal folder on the whole disk and need a token with full disk access that you create yourself.

manual_token.title: Enter OAuth token
manual_token.description: Paste the OAuth token. Get it via the link in the hint.

folder.title: Backup location
folder.description: Backups are stored in this folder. Each Home Assistant instance needs its own folder name.

data_description.instance_folder: Folder inside the app folder for this instance. It is created if missing.
data_description.backup_folder: Folder on your Disk, created if missing.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Yandex Disk
reauth_confirm.description: Your Yandex Disk OAuth token is invalid or has expired. Please enter a new token.

reauth_oauth.title: Reauthenticate Yandex Disk
reauth_oauth.description: Your Yandex Disk authorization has expired. Submit to sign in to Yandex again.

reconfigure.title: Change storage mode
reconfigure.description: Choose the new storage mode. You will authorize Yandex Disk again, and the stored token is replaced.

migration_hint.title: Move existing backups
migration_hint.description: The storage mode changed. Backups in the old location ({old_path}) are not moved automatically and will not be listed anymore. To keep them, open the Yandex Disk web interface, move the files from {old_path} to {new_path}, and move each backup file together with its .metadata.json file.

error.invalid_token: Invalid OAuth token. Please check and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Yandex Disk. Please try again.
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred. Please try again.
error.invalid_instance_folder: Invalid folder name. Avoid empty names, leading or trailing spaces and slashes, dots as path segments, and the characters \ : % ? #.
error.folder_is_file: A file with this name already exists on Yandex Disk where the folder should be.

abort.already_configured: This Yandex Disk account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different Yandex account or backup location. Reauthenticate with the original account.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Yandex Disk. Please try again.
abort.missing_configuration: The Yandex sign-in is not available. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.no_url_available: No Home Assistant URL is available. See {docs_url}.
abort.oauth_failed: Could not get a token from Yandex.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timeout getting a token from Yandex.
